vetBenefits.title: Veteran benefits checklist
vetBenefits.lead: Benefits veterans often miss. Check off each one you have or have looked into. Every link goes to the official government page.
vetBenefits.disability_text: Tax-free monthly money for injuries or illnesses connected to your service. Many veterans never file a claim.
vetBenefits.pension_text: Monthly money for wartime veterans with limited income who are 65 or older, or who have a permanent disability.
vetBenefits.state_text: Many states offer property tax breaks, free or discounted licenses and help with tuition. Find your state's veterans office.
vetBenefits.health_text: Many veterans qualify, even without a disability rating. Applying is the only way to find out.
vetBenefits.life_text: Options like VGLI to keep coverage after you leave the service, and VALife for veterans with a service-connected disability.
vetBenefits.homeLoan_text: Most veterans can buy a home with no down payment and no private mortgage insurance (PMI). Start by getting your Certificate of Eligibility.
vetBenefits.fundingFee_text: If you get VA disability compensation, you usually don't pay the VA funding fee on a home loan. That can save thousands.
vetBenefits.giBill_text: Money for college, trade school, flight training and more, including monthly housing.
vetBenefits.vre_text: Help with job training, school and finding work if you have a service-connected disability.
vetBenefits.business_text: Training, counseling and loan programs from the U.S. Small Business Administration.
vetBenefits.records_text: You need your DD214 for most benefits. Get a copy and keep it somewhere safe.
vetBenefits.id_text: Show you served to get veteran discounts, without carrying your DD214.
vetBenefits.parks_text: Veterans and Gold Star families get free lifetime access to national parks and other federal lands.
vetBenefits.burial_text: Burial in a VA national cemetery, a headstone or marker, and help for your family. Good to know before it's needed.
vetBenefits.crisis: If you or a veteran you know is in crisis: dial 988 and press 1, or text 838255. Free, confidential, 24/7.
vetBenefits.saved: Your checks are saved on this device only.
vetBenefits.notVa: General information, not a decision on benefits. Cuenta Clara is not affiliated with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs or any government agency.

saver.name: The Saver
saver.summary: You like knowing there's money set aside. Saving gives you peace of mind.
saver.strength: You plan ahead and you're ready when surprises happen.
saver.watchOut: Saving so hard that you never enjoy your money, or keeping it where it doesn't grow.
tips: Set a clear savings target, like 3 months of bills, so you know when you've reached enough.
Let your savings grow: money in a high-yield savings or retirement account works for you.
Plan a small amount of guilt-free fun money each month. You've earned it.

spender.name: The Spender
spender.summary: You enjoy life and like using money for things that make you happy today.
spender.strength: You're generous with yourself and others, and you don't let money stress run your life.
spender.watchOut: Running short before payday, or leaning on credit cards to fill the gap.
tips: Pay bills and savings first on payday, then spend what's left freely.
Know what credit cards really cost: the APR on a balance adds up fast.
Build a small emergency fund so one surprise doesn't go on a card.

giver.name: The Giver
giver.summary: Taking care of the people you love comes first, often before yourself.
giver.strength: Your family and friends can count on you. That's a big deal.
giver.watchOut: Helping so much that you have nothing left for your own bills or savings.
tips: Put family help in your plan as a set amount, so you can give without guilt or surprises.
Save for yourself too: an emergency fund protects you and the people who depend on you.
When you send money, compare fees and exchange rates. Small differences add up.

avoider.name: The Avoider
avoider.summary: Money feels stressful, so it's easier not to look. You're far from alone.
avoider.strength: You don't obsess over every dollar, and you're open to a fresh start.
avoider.watchOut: Missed bills, late fees and surprises that could have been avoided.
tips: Look at your money for just 2 minutes, once a week. Small and regular beats perfect.
Paying on time is the biggest part of your credit score. Set reminders for every bill.
Start with one small goal, like $500 for emergencies. Small wins build confidence.

clara.hello: Hi, I'm Clara. Ask me anything about your money, like whether something fits in your budget or what a money word means. I use your own numbers from the app.
suggestions: How much will I have left on payday?
What if I save $200 more a month?
Can I pay off my card by December?
clara.failed: Clara couldn't answer right now. Try again in a moment.
clara.past: {count, plural, one {# past conversation} other {# past conversations}}
clara.deleteBody: It will be removed from your history. This can't be undone.
clara.leftToday: {count, plural, one {# question left today} other {# questions left today}}
clara.leftMonth: {count} of {limit} free questions left this month
clara.limitDay: You've asked your {limit} questions for today. Clara will be here tomorrow.
clara.limitMonth: You've used your {limit} free questions this month. With Plus you can ask Clara 30 questions a day.
clara.disclaimer: General information, not financial advice. The numbers come from your app; Clara explains them and can make mistakes.

whatIf.title: What if?
whatIf.describe: Your bank balance for the next {days} days. As planned it ends at {planned}; {label}, it ends at {withIt}.
whatIf.assumes: Estimate from your numbers: paychecks on paydays, bills on their due dates, sends and savings as planned, and everyday spending at this month's pace.
whatIf.locked: See the next 30, 60 or 90 days with Plus

install.title: Put Cuenta Clara on your home screen
install.lead: Open it like an app, full screen, with one tap.
install.ios1: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow) at the bottom or top of the screen.
install.ios2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen", then "Add".
install.iosSignIn: The first time you open it from your home screen, sign in with your email and password.
